Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers
results.source_text:
/--
If the image of `s` under `f` is finite, and each fiber of `f` has a finite intersection
with `s`, then `s` is itself finite.

It is useful to give `f` explicitly here so this can be used with `apply`.
-/
lemma Finite.of_finite_fibers (f : α → β) {s : Set α} (himage : (f '' s).Finite)
    (hfibers : ∀ x ∈ f '' s, (s ∩ f ⁻¹' {x}).Finite) : s.Finite :=
  (himage.biUnion hfibers).subset fun x ↦ by aesop
results.docstring:
If the image of `s` under `f` is finite, and each fiber of `f` has a finite intersection
with `s`, then `s` is itself finite.

It is useful to give `f` explicitly here so this can be used with `apply`.

results.name: Northcott.comp_of_finite_fibers
results.source_text:
/-- A composition `h' ∘ h` is Northcott when `h'` is Northcott and the fibers of `h` are finite. -/
lemma comp_of_finite_fibers [LE γ] [Northcott h'] [Filter.TendstoCofinite h] :
    Northcott (h' ∘ h) where
  finite_le c := by
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers h ?_ fun x _ ↦
      (Filter.TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton h x).inter_of_right _
    exact (finite_le (h := h') c).subset <| by grind
results.docstring: A composition `h' ∘ h` is Northcott when `h'` is Northcott and the fibers of `h` are finite.

lemma sum_over_length {s : CrAnSection φs} (f : Fin s.1.length → M)
    [AddCommMonoid M] : ∑ (n : Fin s.1.length), f n =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs.length), f (Fin.cast (length_eq s).symm n) := by
  rw [← (finCongr (length_eq s)).sum_comp]
  rfl

/-- The cardinality of a `Branch` is the total number of leafs. -/
def Branch.card {α2 α3 α4 : Type} (T : Branch α2 α3 α4) : Nat :=
  match T with
  | .branch _ twigs => (twigs.map Twig.card).sum

results.name: Fintype
results.source_text:
/-- `Fintype α` means that `α` is finite, i.e. there are only
  finitely many distinct elements of type `α`. The evidence of this
  is a finset `elems` (a list up to permutation without duplicates),
  together with a proof that everything of type `α` is in the list. -/
class Fintype (α : Type*) where
  /-- The `Finset` containing all elements of a `Fintype` -/
  elems : Finset α
  /-- A proof that `elems` contains every element of the type -/
  complete : ∀ x : α, x ∈ elems
results.docstring:
`Fintype α` means that `α` is finite, i.e. there are only
